name: Sabarimala
summary: A major hilltop pilgrimage. The Mandala–Makaravilakku season (mid-Nov to mid-Jan) draws huge crowds; entry and dress rules apply.
considerations: Open to pilgrims only in set seasons (mainly mid-November to mid-January) and the first days of each Malayalam month.
Entry follows temple customs, which have been the subject of court cases. Check the official Sabarimala website before planning.
The final approach is a steep forest walk of about 5 km (3 mi) from Pamba.
todo: Read the official rules before planning a visit
